correctness_confidence.basis: Formalized in an 18-theorem zero-dependency Lean 4 kernel with 0 sorry, 0 warnings, and 0 Classical.choice, alongside DELEGATION-CERT-1.0 passing 60/60 adversarial forgeries.

rigor.basis: Rigorously verifies exact rational knapsack separation, degree-7 Bernstein polynomial positivity, Taylor bounds, and algorithm score invariants without floats.

significance.basis: Advances mechanized algorithmic game theory by establishing absolute exact-rational verification for complex combinatorial mechanism design bounds.

summary: The paper presents a machine-checked exact-rational formalization and verification framework for downward-closed combinatorial delegated choice, knapsack impossibility, and Bernstein positivity. Featuring an 18-theorem zero-dependency Lean 4 kernel and a pure-stdlib Python exact-Q verifier auditing 16 canonical certificates, the work achieves flawless verification of complex game-theoretic bounds without floating-point approximations.
weaknesses: Scope excludes continuous stop-loss integrals and large-scale LP duals of Section 10
